title: struct native layout and standard layout
summary: @ takes native size, endianness, and alignment; <, >, !, and = do not insert native alignment padding.
applies: Python 3; standard library or built-in integers
detail: On common x86-64 the I of @BI starts at offset 4, while the I of <BI follows the first byte, making the entire record 5 bytes.
boundary: = Use native endianness and standard sizes; cross-end data still needs to know the actual endianness.
relevance: Check padding semantics when the same field table is gradually misaligned in different parsers.
